title: Inline photo notes and the rich markdown editor

completion_criteria.text: The four rich-editor audits (prototype editor, app capture/storage, package landscape, single-TextField substrate limits) are complete, cited, and committed under docs/specs/research/
The editor substrate architecture is decided and recorded as a decision record with its rejected alternatives and pre-mortem
A detailed spec covering BOTH the rich markdown editor AND OQ-6 exists, orders the editor strictly before OQ-6, and resolves every unreachable value at spec time
The existing P0-P5 inline-photo ladder has been re-read against the no-wrap-in-EditableText limit and either amended or explicitly re-affirmed
The spec is implemented via mitosis, every MSP leaving note capture working on its own merge commit
No schema migration was required, or one shipped as its own MSP with a successful-upgrade test and a rollback proven on a copy of a real journal

spine.active_goal: Ship the rich markdown editor (E0-E7), then OQ-6's inline anchored photos (P0-P5) on it -- one controller seam, editor first, no schema migration. Spec is WRITTEN, HARDENED, CITATION-PROVEN, ANCHOR-CORRECTED and DISPATCH-READY: docs/specs/2026-08-03-rich-editor-and-inline-photos.md (branch inline-photo/spec, 9cd0e1f). It AMENDS docs/specs/2026-08-02-inline-photo-notes.md by resolution number (A1-A12) and adds its own D1-D8; read BOTH.
spine.next_step: Dispatch mitosis. Order is fixed by the computed overlap matrix (spec 7.1/7.2): E0 -> {P0 parallel P1} -> E1 -> E2 -> E3 -> E4 -> E5 -> E6* -> E7* -> P2 -> P3 -> P4 -> P5. Start with E0: test-only gate, zero files under lib/, 6 cases proving the char-for-char invariant over the 12-feature grammar in spec 3.1. All prior blockers CLOSED.
open_risks: The ~60 [inherited] citations in the sibling OUTSIDE the 28 proven anchors remain UNVERIFIED. Spec 0.1's duty -- re-open every one -- stands for them.

The OQ-6 decision record still cites app_database_test.dart:97-128 and app_database.dart:20-37. Deliberately NOT edited: decision records are write-once after acceptance. The correction lives in the specs; do not trust the record's anchors.

splitSpanAt (A1) is the one genuinely new algorithm in the spec and is UNSPIKED: asserted tractable, never proven. If P3 finds it harder, that is a finding against A1, not an implementer judgement call.
E1 MUST preserve P1's stripPhotoAnchors call (spec 7.1). Built against a pre-P1 NoteBody the stripper is silently dropped and every stored U+FFFC renders as tofu -- exactly what R7 exists to prevent.
The spec was hardened ONE round then patched four times; NOT re-reviewed since D1-D8, the matrix, the citation proof and the anchor corrections landed. A second pass to convergence is owed before P2.
D5 grows P2's traversal matrix from 6 to 10 cases (delta +15, not +11); D2 grows E7 to +6 if E6 is dropped. The sibling's absolute test totals are void (A7); its per-phase deltas stand.
R0 IS STILL LIVE (A12): inline-photo/spec has NOT merged, so anyone branching from main cannot read either decision record OR the spec. Every dispatch names the branch or quotes the records inline.

NO DATABASE MIGRATION, EVER. schemaVersion is 1 and onUpgrade unconditionally throws. The refusal is pinned by app_database_test.dart:98-128 ALONE. A wrong first migration makes every existing journal unopenable.
Baseline 944 passed / analyze clean was NOT re-measured this session. Measure it on your own branch; it has gone stale three times.
gh pr create and gh pr merge are BOTH denied globally. PRs go through the pr-create tool; every merge is human. CI IS NOT EVIDENCE -- no GitHub check runs a Dart test here.
Predicted first failure: type-to-transform x undo/redo x IME composing (E4). Gate every programmatic mutation on composing.isCollapsed.
out_of_scope: OQ-3 (entry-card Edit/Delete placement) — deliberately set aside by the user; still the last open criterion of the separate prototype-design-alignment thread.
Nested lists and indent, links, and custom undo/redo beyond Flutter's built-in UndoHistory — none exist in the prototype to reference.
Any editor package: super_editor, flutter_quill, appflowy_editor, re_editor and flutter_markdown are all rejected on named constraints.
Any database migration or schema change.
Editable text that wraps around an inline object — structurally impossible in Flutter; write mode stays plain.
Arbitrary pixel positioning of photos. The anchor is a position in the text, never an (x, y).
